description: # Support google search Update 7/23 Support key from either https://serper.dev/ or https://serpapi.com/ or Google API. Smart mode is tricky. Will not implement in this PR. --- ~~Need key from https://serper.dev/ ~~ - Support search Google using google-serper API in LLM. - Add checkbox on the React web UI for enabling google search. - ~~Add search result back to embedding store for future reference.~~ - Build a Command system `[!COMMAND]CONTENT` to support command from client to backend using Websocket. Sample output: Ask Elon about the current Tesla stock price. I did not enable the Google Search for the first question and enable it for the same question. TODO - Update Readme. - Support Anthropic. - Smart mode to decide if enable Google Search or not. - Better command system. (Maybe change Text to Json)

comments.body: qq, why does it need to add in db? since if search enabled, it will always search internet
qq, is it possible to set limit on how much token it will use?
I am little concerned that the search result may take too many tokens, which man confuse LLM

Umm yeah I was originally planning to have the smart mode to automatically decide if need to search web. In that case, it makes sense to add in db for future reference. 
But I found it is not easy job so I want to reserve it for future work. I can remove this part if you think it should not be included in this simple mode.

I do not think there is such way to limit the token out of box. But according to my experience, since the LLM will summarize the search result first, the result is always pretty short. For example, for the question above in the screenshot, the agent will just reply `Tesla's current stock price is 260.02.` instead of returning all the search result. Maybe we can add one more step in the chain to limit the words. Maybe we can wait until getting some feedbacks.
